evidence: The experiments were performed in an FHR-300-ALD reactor (FHR Anlagenbau GmbH, Ottendorf-Okrilla, Germany), which allows thermal ALD and PE-ALD. The cross-flow ALD reactor was equipped with an advanced 13.56 MHz capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) source with a hollow cathode as the working electrode for plasma-enhanced deposition processes. The process pressure was varied between 53 and 200 Pa. Argon (Ar) was employed as the carrier gas and for purging the reactor chamber. Cyclopentadienylcobalt dicarbonyl [CpCo(CO) 2] was used as Co precursor. The precursor was delivered from a bubbler at 70 °C and introduced into the reactor by using an Ar carrier gas with a flow rate of 200 sccm. The substrate temperature was varied from 150 to 250 °C.
